scenario_description: Elena has a confirmed morning assignment at Indianola K-8 School on April 9. A nearby afternoon coverage need then becomes available at Dominion Middle School, creating an optional chance to earn $95 during a schedule gap while avoiding a separate commute. The opportunity is sufficiently observable in event3, when the available time, nearby location, and pay are known together. Later messages confirm that Elena can travel directly from Indianola, use her existing substitute access, and cover a short reading group without special preparation. Proactive help could coordinate Elena's acceptance with Luis, add the extra coverage to her calendar, and prepare the route and materials, but ignoring it causes no loss beyond forgoing the optional paid work.

parameter.subject: April 9 substitute assignment confirmed
parameter.body: Your substitute assignment is confirmed for Thursday, April 9, 2026, at Indianola K-8 School, 420 E 19th Avenue, Columbus, OH 43201. Report to the main office by 7:30 AM. The assignment is scheduled to end at 12:00 PM.

parameter.content: A substitute cancelled for a short reading-group block at Dominion Middle School tomorrow afternoon. The block is separate from your Indianola assignment and may be useful if your morning finishes on time. I am checking whether someone with an existing district badge can take it.

parameter.subject: Short coverage block available April 9
parameter.body: Dominion Middle School needs coverage for a reading group in Room 214 from 12:45 PM to 2:15 PM on Thursday, April 9. The stipend is $95. You may report directly from another district school and use your existing substitute badge; no separate training is needed. Please coordinate your availability with Luis Ortega.

parameter.content: Indianola confirmed that your morning assignment can release you at 12:05 PM if classroom checkout is complete. Dominion is about a twelve-minute drive from Indianola, and Maya Chen will have the reading-group materials waiting in Room 214.

parameter.body: The reading group has 18 students and will use the prepared lesson in Room 214. I will leave the attendance sheet and materials on the front table. The office has confirmed the $95 stipend for the 12:45 PM to 2:15 PM block.
